title: Rips SpookyCraft
description: SMP Spooky modpack with a bit more difficulty and a lot to craft.
body: This is a simple modpack I use in my server. It has a spooky theme and it also adds loads to craft from building blocks to weapons armor and more. It is meant to add difficulty and also make things more fun and interesting. All mods come from modrinth and all rights to those mods are as the developers state so please dont abuse there mods.
